cohort: A total of 783,988 mother-neonate-father trios participating in the National Free Preconception Checkups Project in Guangdong Province, China, between 2014 and 2019.
finding: Paternal age was independently associated with an increased risk of caesarean section and preterm birth, with the risk of preterm birth showing a dose-dependent J-shaped association, while no significant association was found for small for gestational age or perinatal infant death.
